svg.text: OSCoST 1-Wire edition: 1 × Pt1000 + 7 × DS18B20 + PWM pump (reference installation, alternative wiring)

g.text: 40-pin header to the Pi (stacking header for the Pi 5 cooler)

svg.text: OSCoST HAT on the Raspberry Pi
1-Wire bus A: one 3-wire cable, daisy chain
1-Wire bus B: one 3-wire cable, daisy chain
Required: a high-efficiency pump with a PWM input in the SOLAR profile
(Wilo PWM2 / iPWM2, Grundfos profile C): no signal or a broken cable = pump stops.
A heating-profile pump (no signal = full speed) is not safe without a cut-off relay.
